name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Edmund goes with Cooper or someone in the River Ward goes with Fletcher.
Eastcheap goes with at least two of Cedric, Potter, and Barrels.
Cooper goes with exactly two of Aldric, Rope, and Eastcheap.
Between Edmund and Fletcher, one goes with Millpond and the other with Southgate.
Exactly two of (the members of the Market Ward, the artisan who makes Pottery, and Edmund) belong to the Joiners' Guild.

So Edmund does not go with Kingsford.
